For raw str(owner), explicit NavItem.label, and child plural labels, remove SafeData the same way but never entity-decode them: literal entity-looking input must remain literal. First tests prove this real path, not only builder return dictionaries. Prove a declaration can precede registration of its owner and child, then renders after they register. Pydantic handles field-type errors at construction. Addresses review concern R11: items=[] is valid and renders nothing; NavItem() is structurally representable but an attached item with neither a nonempty owner key nor a nonempty child name is a named startup error.
